note: Every element in app/index.html that a user can see or act on must be classified here.
`wired` = the module script drives it. `static` = it is not a control, and this is why.
check:app fails when an element is unclassified, when a manifest entry names something the
shell no longer has, or when a `wired` claim has no reference in app/**/*.ts.
PARADIGM (2026-09-23): `wired` only proves a reference exists. A control is honest only if
clicking it has an observable outcome — action, or a visible error. Silent `return` on a
failed precondition is a dead control (＋ NEW after 6190ad4). check:app bans that guard shape.
Empty lists must offer the recovery action in the empty state itself (see sessionsList, stream).
Why this file exists: three rail items were written as <div>s, so the control scan never saw
them, and they stayed dead while every gate reported green. A gap can hide by simply not
being counted; this file makes not-counting a build failure.

viewProcess.role: nav pad: the work record view (current view = light block)

viewEvents.role: nav pad: the raw event log view

infoToggle.role: ⓘ: show / hide transport diagnostics in the right column

newSession.role: blue tile: create a fresh session (the page's one primary entry)

sessionsRefresh.role: session list: reload the engine's session list

cwdInput.role: workspace: editable project directory used for the next engine restart

cwdBrowse.role: workspace: choose a directory in the operating system folder picker and import it

cwdApply.role: workspace: apply the directory and restart the engine

permissionPolicy.role: workspace: read and update project permission.edit policy

promptInput.role: dock: instruction box (Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, Esc halts a running turn)

promptSubmit.role: dock: send the instruction (hidden while a turn runs)

halt.role: dock: interrupt the running turn via session/cancel (shown only while a turn runs)

restart.role: engine box: kill and respawn the engine process

modes.static: container only; the runtime's mode buttons are created inside it from configOptions

options.static: container only; selects are created from the runtime's configOptions

tools.static: container only; the work-order index rows are created from the event stream

stream.static: container only; instruction / reply / work-order blocks (and the empty state with its CREATE button) are created by the renderer

eventsList.static: container only; the event log rows are created by the renderer

eventsView.static: the EVENTS surface itself; reached by the viewEvents button

processView.static: the RECORD surface itself; reached by the viewProcess button

toolInspector.static: floating work-order detail panel; content is rendered from the selected tool event

toolInspectorKind.static: text label for the selected tool kind

toolInspectorTitle.static: text title for the selected work order

toolInspectorStatus.static: text status for the selected work order

toolInspectorId.static: text tool call identifier for the selected work order

toolInspectorBody.static: container for renderer-created work-order detail rows

toolInspectorClose.role: floating work-order detail panel close action

transportPanel.static: section shown or hidden by infoToggle; contains no controls

sessionsList.static: container only; session tiles (load / delete) and the empty / failed states with their recovery buttons are created by the renderer from session/list

approvalBar.static: approval card; option buttons are created from session/request_permission.options

approvalSummary.static: text only; shows the pending request summary

approvalActions.static: container only; buttons created from the engine's permission options

button.role: renderer-created action button; concrete label comes from runtime state
